comment: Which facet names can be the name of a folder (wave 020, run 0146, issue #147, decision T2). `problem` is the sentence for a name that cannot, null for a name that can; the command line (FacetNames, FacetNamesTest.java) and the editor (facetNameProblem and validateFacetName, facet-names.test.js) say it word for word. The sentences of a workspace file that holds such a name are the cases N94 to N104 of negative-cases.json.
